name: broadcast
instructions: Is this sender automated or one-to-many rather than a person writing to the owner: a newsletter, digest, marketing or product announcement, receipt, notification, calendar or system mail, mass outreach, or cold sales/recruiting the owner never meaningfully engaged with? A person who also sends newsletters is NOT this when any message is a genuine person-to-person exchange. Judge only the supplied evidence.

name: mailbox
instructions: Is this a shared or organizational address rather than one person: a team, support, billing, investor-relations, back-office, admin, info@ or no-reply account, a fund or company inbox that several people write from, or a role account such as ir@, portfolio@ or finance@? Judge from the identifiers and how the messages are signed; one named person writing from their own address is NOT this.

name: vendor_only
instructions: Is the owner's only relationship with this contact buying something from them: a provider the owner books, orders from, pays, or gets support from (clothing, travel, hospitality, banking or billing support, legal or accounting paperwork, logistics), with nothing beyond those transactions? A provider the owner also knows socially or works with on something else is NOT this.

name: intermediary
instructions: Is this contact acting only on someone else's behalf: an assistant, executive assistant, scheduler, coordinator or paralegal arranging meetings, documents or logistics for another person, with no relationship of their own with the owner? Judge only the supplied evidence.
